# Researching how GenAI reshapes learning

I study how GenAI influences teaching, learning, and evaluation at scale. My work connects educational technology, data science, and research methods to support responsible, effective classroom integration.

- GenAI use in higher education and classroom practice
- Educational data science and large-scale assessment
- Evaluation methodology for technology-enabled learning

### askabout.edu

**Co-founder · Working prototype**

Evidence-informed decision support that helps educators turn verified research into context-aware answers with transparent citations and evidence-strength ratings.

[Explore Ask About EDU →](Projects/Ask_About_EDU/Ask_About_EDU.qmd)

### Computational Analysis of Educational Data
A first-author CRC Press field guide to analyzing text, relational, numeric, and multimodal educational data with R and modern AI methods.

[Explore the book →](Publications/Computational_Analysis_Educational_Data/Book.qmd)

### AIREA Data Explorer
